document:
From: priya.nair@synthetic-magnetics.example
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: RE: MCB-02 leakage fit / which gap value goes into the reference model

The v1.0 file still has sigma=0.05. That was the early idealized estimate.

The calibration fit using the nominal geometry is closer to sigma=0.08. I have CR-MAG-006 in approval now.

Also: the technician measured 1.58 mm at the physical shim stack. Please do NOT silently replace the 1.50 mm nominal gap in the analytic benchmark. We need both:
- nominal model: delta=1.50 mm
- prototype/as-built validation configuration: delta=1.58 mm

---- reply ----
From: daniel.cho@synthetic-magnetics.example
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:01:00 +0100

Understood. One more mismatch: CoreCatalog_A says mu_r=1000, but the batch characterization sheet used 1200. CR-MAG-004 already approved 1200 for the linear reference benchmark.

The old measurement-coil sketch also says 40 turns. Coil Data B says 50 and has the polarity dots.

---- approval ----
From: a.mehta@synthetic-magnetics.example
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 16:20:00 +0100
Subject: CR-MAG-006 approved

Approved sigma=0.08 for the released nominal benchmark. Archive the 0.05 model for traceability.
